program_summary.description: Builds an analysis-ready reporting unit file for a single quarter by merging the control file and prior-quarter total compensation onto collected cost microdata, retaining units above a total-compensation threshold, and computing compensation per 100 hours paid plus a quarter-over-quarter change in compensation. Also averages compensation and benefits by industry into a review table.

macro_reference.name: qtr_cost
macro_reference.purpose: Joins the control file D2 and prior-quarter file D3 onto raw cost microdata, applies the total-compensation retention threshold, derives the compensation rate and quarter-over-quarter change, and writes WORK.O1 plus the by-industry summary for quarter `p`.

variable_dictionary.name: RUID
variable_dictionary.label: Reporting unit identifier
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through unchanged from the merged input datasets (join key).

variable_dictionary.name: IND
variable_dictionary.label: Industry classification code
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through unchanged from the merged input datasets (join key).

variable_dictionary.name: QTR
variable_dictionary.label: Quarter label YYYYQn
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through from the input file when populated; if blank, backfilled from the &p macro variable at call time.

variable_dictionary.name: BCOST
variable_dictionary.label: Benefit cost
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through unchanged from the raw microdata file D1.

variable_dictionary.name: HRSP
variable_dictionary.label: Total hours paid
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through unchanged from the raw microdata file D1.

variable_dictionary.name: TCOMP
variable_dictionary.label: Total compensation cost
variable_dictionary.derivation: brought in from the control file D2 in the join.

variable_dictionary.name: WCOST
variable_dictionary.label: Wage and salary cost
variable_dictionary.derivation: brought in from the control file D2 in the join.

variable_dictionary.name: EDTF
variable_dictionary.label: Edit action flag (A/E/I)
variable_dictionary.derivation: brought in from the control file D2 in the join.

variable_dictionary.name: P_TCOMP
variable_dictionary.label: Prior-period total compensation cost
variable_dictionary.derivation: prior-period value joined from the prior-quarter file D3 for period-over-period comparison.

variable_dictionary.name: TCDIF
variable_dictionary.label: Total compensation change vs prior period

variable_dictionary.name: TCOMPR
variable_dictionary.label: Total compensation cost per 100 hours paid
variable_dictionary.derivation: computed as round(100*TCOMP/HRSP, 0.01) when TCOMP > 0, else set to missing.

variable_dictionary.name: IND
variable_dictionary.label: Industry classification code
variable_dictionary.derivation: grouping variable carried through from the class statement (IND).

variable_dictionary.name: TCOMP
variable_dictionary.label: Total compensation cost (mean across records)
variable_dictionary.derivation: computed via PROC SUMMARY as the mean of this variable across records sharing the same IND (name unchanged from the input -- the `mean=;` output statement was not given explicit new names).

variable_dictionary.name: BCOST
variable_dictionary.label: Benefit cost (mean across records)
variable_dictionary.derivation: computed via PROC SUMMARY as the mean of this variable across records sharing the same IND (name unchanged from the input -- the `mean=;` output statement was not given explicit new names).
